name: Accessibility check on component save
description: When a file in components/ is saved, review it against .kiro/steering/accessibility.md and report every violation.

then.prompt: Review the component file that was just saved against #[[file:.kiro/steering/accessibility.md]]. Go through the 11 rules one by one. Report each violation as: rule number, line, what is wrong, and the exact fix. Check especially: contrast pairs, icon plus text for every state, aria-live and role on status/loading/error regions, visible labels, 44px tap targets (min-h-[44px]), focus not removed, heading order, and loading/empty/error states for any fetch. If there are no violations, reply 'No accessibility violations found' and list the rules you checked.
